support.title: Help and support
support.subtitle: Frequently asked questions and contact.

faq.a1: No. Tickets labeled “Demo” are fictitious, have no access code and grant access to no event.
faq.q2: How do I publish an event?
faq.a2: Create an organizer profile in the organizer space, then click “Create an event”. Publishing is free.
faq.q3: Why is my event in review?
faq.a3: Events from unverified organizations are reviewed by the team to limit fake events.
faq.a4: Only tickets issued through Tamurt can be resold, at a capped price, with the ticket reissued to the buyer. It is currently a demo.
faq.q5: How do I delete my account?
faq.a5: Go to Settings > Delete my account. You'll be asked to confirm with your password.

support.contactText: Beta tester? Use the Tamurt Beta feedback form to report a bug or suggest an improvement.
